ValidationRule.description: QA fix (Defect #3): blocks inserting a reservation directly as Expired/Converted/Cancelled, skipping the real lifecycle. EvaluateApproval only sets Requested/Pending Approval/Reserved on create.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), OR( ISPICKVAL(AF_Status__c, "Expired"), ISPICKVAL(AF_Status__c, "Converted"), ISPICKVAL(AF_Status__c, "Cancelled") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A reservation cannot be created directly as Expired, Converted, or Cancelled - it must start as Requested and progress through the real lifecycle.
